items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He followed Lionel Hampton and he preceded Milt Jackson by a few inches, few seconds in the modern jazz idiom.

ctx.x: …record it, and we did, we’ve done several recordings together over the years. And Terry is a delight to be with because he’s really off the wall most of the time; he’s a silly guy. In fact, when we’re taking pictures I always say, “Say something funny, Terry Gibbs” so he would smile. He was one of the great innovators in modern jazz also. He followed Lionel Hampton and he preceded Milt Jackson by a few inches, few seconds in the modern jazz idiom. And he was responsible for, in many ways, for the popularity of…
You two have extremely different personalities, but clearly that must have been, they must have been complimentary?
